Message.Name: Refresh Request Message
Message.Description: Sent by the firm over the DoM Retransmission Interface (ESeSM Unsequenced Data Packet) to request a Last Value Refresh of a particular data set identified by Refresh Message Type.

Field.Name: Refresh Message Type
Field.Description: Identifies the data set the firm is requesting a refresh of.

Message.Name: Refresh Response Message
Message.Description: Sent by MIAX Pearl Equities over the DoM Retransmission Interface (ESeSM Unsequenced Data Packet) carrying one Application Message that satisfies a previous Refresh Request.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: For Symbol Update/Trading Status/System State refreshes this is the original sequence number from the live feed; for Order Book refresh this is the last sequence number on the live feed at the time of the refresh request.

Message.Name: End of Refresh Notification Message
Message.Description: Sent by MIAX Pearl Equities over the DoM Retransmission Interface (ESeSM Unsequenced Data Packet) when the refresh response is complete.

Field.Name: Refresh Message Type
Field.Description: Echoes the Refresh Message Type from the originating Refresh Request.
